source_review.notes: Reviewed the original Summary Cache counting-filter work; primary scalable, stable, improved-counting, compressed-counting, survey, and time-limited-filter sources from academic/author hosts and records. All seven final destinations returned HTTP 200. Counter-width, error-rate, stable-history, and application claims remain scoped to the cited models and workloads.

evidence: Checked counter vector C in [0,M], position multiset/deduplicated set P(x), exact live multiplicity A(x), and projected bit B[j]=1[C[j]>0].
Checked scalable layer capacity n_i, bits m_i, probes k_i, bound p_i, false-positive event F_i, target P, and geometric ratio r remain distinct.
Checked union-bound and independence-product statements are labeled with their different dependence premises.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Counter values are consistently described as aggregate hash contributions rather than exact per-key frequency.

evidence: Recomputed two-layer union bound 0.04+0.02=0.06 and independent composition 1-(0.96)(0.98)=0.0592.
Recomputed ten independent one-percent layers as 1-0.99^10=0.0956179 versus union bound 0.10.
Recomputed P=0.02,r=0.25 budgets as 0.015,0.00375,0.0009375,0.000234375; sum 0.019921875 and remaining infinite budget 0.000078125.
Recomputed doubling capacities 100k+200k+400k+800k=1.5M.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The executable layer budgets are declared fixtures; its finite bit layouts are not proven to realize those probabilities.

evidence: Verified owned deletion removes exactly one accepted occurrence contribution and preserves at least one contribution for every remaining occurrence.
Verified saturating while losing increments followed by ordinary decrement can undercount and eventually create false negatives.
Verified scalable OR-query false positives form a union, bounded by sum p_i without independence, and geometric p_i=P(1-r)r^i sums to P.
Verified a bounded aggregate probability does not bound layer-query fan-out.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Concurrent linearizability and durable transactions are design obligations, not mechanically proven implementations.

evidence: Reviewed zero/max counters, wrap, saturation, overflow sentinels/side state, underflow, repeated positions, partial updates, duplicates, unowned/delayed deletes, and generation reuse.
Reviewed zero/full layers, equal versus geometric budgets, dependence, infinite layers, query fan-out, routing, consolidation, reader pins, and mutation delta capture.
Reviewed skew/chosen collisions, corrupt checkpoints, exact-ledger divergence, crashes, rolling formats, stable-filter intentional forgetting, capacity alarms, and safe rebuild/bypass.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The executable model excludes repeated positions for exercised keys, concurrency, persistence, corruption, saturation, distributional experiments, and actual probability validation.

evidence: The CBF model preflights all positions before increment, accepts exactly three duplicate occurrences at max 3, rejects the fourth, and proves rejection leaves all counters unchanged.
Exact ownership rejects unowned key 23; deleting owned 11 preserves maybe for remaining 7 and 19 and yields the fixture-specific absence of 11.
The scalable model rolls over exactly at capacities 2 and 4, inserts six members into two layers, and exhaustively checks all six remain positive.
Exact output checks counter, deletion, layer, budget, composition, and aggregate validity fields.
invariant_checking.notes: Python dictionaries supply exact ownership only for the finite model and are not evidence for a production ownership service.

evidence: Reviewed owned-deletion proof from exact generation/layer multiplicity through recorded contribution, preflight, atomic decrement, remaining-member positivity, and reject-before-mutation cases.
Reviewed scalable budget proof from per-layer bounds and OR semantics through union bound, summable allocation, fan-out separation, and rounding revalidation.
Reviewed lifecycle evidence proof across exact oracle, sequential/concurrent histories, persistence faults, probability/capacity measurement, rebuild, compatibility, and rollback.
proof_review.notes: No formal counter-tail bound, concurrent algorithm, persistence protocol, or concrete scalable-filter error theorem was implemented.

evidence: Owned-deletion, scalable-budget, and lifecycle-evidence structures are separately labeled with explicit premises.
Union bounds, independence estimates, finite fixture budgets, counter-width guidance, and stable-filter semantics are not conflated.
The chapter explicitly denies that maybe authorizes delete, counters give exact frequency, or successful model execution proves target probabilities.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Scalable retention and stable forgetting are kept as different contracts.

evidence: The standard-library Python model passed exact sixteen-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the repository verifier.
Independent recomputation reproduced all geometric budgets, composition probabilities, layer sums, and capacity calculations.
All seven final external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local Markdown/front-matter/link/snippet checks passed before review.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No packed CBF, randomized counter-load study, scalable false-positive experiment, stable stream, concurrency/fault/recovery test, cache benchmark, distributed ownership system, or production deployment was run.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter makes exact ownership the deletion authority, treats overflow/atomicity as correctness, and separates scalable memory/error composition from stable bounded-memory forgetting.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed set/multiset API, deletion handles and epochs, repeated positions, bounded transactions, overflow side state/rebuild, layer routing, fan-out/consolidation, WAL/checkpoints, concurrency publication, metrics, and state-machine/fault testing.

pedagogical_review.notes: The one-page review identifies the two lifecycle extensions; the finite model exposes rejection nonmutation and layer budgeting; ten examples cover ownership, arithmetic, composition, persistence, generations, consolidation, and forgetting; five exercises provide complete designs and calculations.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/academic-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Fan, Cao, Almeida, Broder, Baquero, Preguica, Hutchison, Deng, Rafiei, Bonomi, Ficara, distributed-systems, database, concurrency, security, performance, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and model prove neither a production counting/scalable/stable filter, counter-width tail bound, concrete layer false-positive rate, concurrent/persistent ownership protocol, certification, nor deployment fitness.
